programs.name: United MileagePlus
programs.qualification: Earned in a calendar year for the following year (qualify by December 31, 2026, for 2027) on Premier qualifying points (PQP) and Premier qualifying flights (PQF), with at least four United or United Express flights. One million lifetime miles gives Premier status for life. Status earned in a year is valid through January 31 of the year after next.

tiers.name: Premier Silver
benefits: Economy Plus at check-in for you and 1 companion
2 more miles per dollar on United flights

tiers.name: Premier Gold
benefits: Economy Plus at booking for you and 1 companion
Free upgrades from 48 hours before the flight
3 more miles per dollar on United flights
United Club All Access authorized-user passes on the United Club card

tiers.name: Premier Platinum
benefits: Economy Plus at booking for you and 8 companions
Free upgrades from 72 hours before the flight
4 more miles per dollar on United flights

tiers.name: Premier 1K
benefits: Economy Plus at booking for you and 8 companions
Free upgrades from 96 hours before the flight
6 more miles per dollar on United flights
Free drink and snack in Economy
